lines.zh: 我拖着黄沙甲壳爬过沙丘。
lines.en: I crawl the dunes in yellow sand shell.

lines.zh: 六条腿在沙上留下深沟。
lines.en: Six legs plough deep grooves.

lines.zh: 我的巨颚在沙里刮出声。
lines.en: My huge mandibles rasp the sand.
The desert is hot. My shell hotter.
Each step sinks. I am not quick.
I patrol sideways over the sand.
Wings buzz under my shell.
I walk toward stirring sand.
I push the sand aside.

lines.zh: 我的腿在沙里划出六道沟。
lines.en: My legs cut six grooves through the sand.
My shell throws back the sun.
I stop in the shade.
My track is wide, like a plough's.
Every so often, I shake off sand.
I walk straight. No detours.
My wings test the air.
I fold my mandibles and rest.

lines.zh: 黄沙甲壳和沙地一个颜色。
lines.en: My shell matches the sand.

lines.zh: 我在听沙子下面的动静。
lines.en: I listen under the sand.
Not much to see out here.
My jaws close like pliers.
The sun is fierce. I stay still.

lines.zh: 我贴着背阴的岩石歇脚。
lines.en: I rest against the shaded rock.
My wings fan slowly beneath.
Sand piles at my legs.
I count the shapes of dunes.

lines.zh: 我的同类在附近，两只一起。
lines.en: My kind are near. Two together.
I barely breathe to save water.
You stepped in my groove.
My mandibles are longer than your arm.
Few living things in this desert.
I smell the water on you.
Not in front. My jaws are there.
Slow crawl. Fast clamp.
I patrol this sand.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，能敲开我？
lines.en: Will that crack my shell?
The sand buries your prints.
Standing back. Wise.
A line shows on my shell.
I tip and push back up.
My shell is the color of yellow sand.
I hiss. A dull sound.
A chip has come off my jaw.
One jaw sits crooked.
These mandibles can flip sand.
The shell cracked. Not through.
I make no noise. Beetles are quiet.
Still up. Legs still planted.
Sweet? Nothing sweet here.
That fruit is still dripping.
I do not eat that. I chew wood.
Leave it on the sand and it dries.
That dead wood interests me more.

lines.zh: 你的手离我的颚只有一拃。
lines.en: Your hand is a span from my jaws.
Food does little for a beetle.
Keep your hand from my jaws.
Sand-shelled chitin crunches in one bite.
Leave it. I will go and get it.
You hit my shell like a plank.
My shoulder plate shoves you off.
My legs cave in the sand.
You step back; sand fills your boots.
My shell is hard. That did nothing.
The bump flips me over.
I struggle back upright.
You stepped on one of my legs.
This armor was not grown for nothing.
Move. I am crawling through.
In the desert, we come two by two.
My grubs lie under the sand.
The season is short.
Odd question for a beetle.

lines.zh: 我的颚是为了争偶长的。
lines.en: These jaws grew for rivals.
Stay off that patch of sand.

lines.zh: 我们不太说话，只碰触角。
lines.en: We speak little. We touch antennae.
Sand covers it all.
Find water instead of asking.
Back off. That is all.
I clamp the dead wood.
Your waterskin. Not my concern.
I push the sand with my jaws.

lines.zh: 我用颚把甲壳翻了个面。
lines.en: I flip the shell over with my jaws.
That old shell plate is mine.
I drag it into my burrow.
Too heavy. I dragged it half a mile.
I bite your arrow in two.
Picking things up in sand is hard.
Mine. Do not reach.
I raise my mandibles.
You trampled my groove.
My wings stop under the shell.
I sidestep your way.
This clamp aims at a leg.
Your water-smell is too strong.

lines.zh: 沙下面有东西在动，是你。
lines.en: Something moves under the sand. You.
No retreat in the desert.
The sand moves. The sand itself.
I start crawling. Fast.
I press in sideways, little by little.
Sand slides away beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 我听着沙里你的落脚点。
lines.en: I listen for where your feet land.
I cast my shadow to your feet.
I open my jaws wider.
Retreat and sand takes your feet.
The dune blocks your view.
No hurry. My shell endures sun.

lines.zh: 你听见壳下的嗡嗡声吗？
lines.en: Hear the buzzing below my shell?
One block more and you are in reach.
My jaws clamp your calf.
I drag you half into the sand.
My shell hits you loudly.
That threw up a spray of sand.
My jaws lock on your shield.
You pull back; I keep coming.
I gouge the desert floor.
You should not have taken that standing.
Sand gets in your wound.
I release, and you breathe.
The dune bulges.

lines.zh: 黄沙甲壳从沙里露出来。
lines.en: A yellow shell breaks the sand.
A giant beetle joins the desert.
Scraping under the sand.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的沙，站起来。
lines.en: I shake the sand off and stand.
Two at a time. Never one.
The sandstorm ends. I emerge.
My jaws catch the light.
I patrol this dune.
I crawl to a stone and stop.
Fire makes my shell brittle.
I roll down the dune, shell first.
Water in my seams and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 沙粒被震得打进我的关节。
lines.en: Blast-driven sand jams into my joints.
The arrow sparks off my shell.
Arts stiffen my legs.
No dead wood and I hollow out.

lines.zh: 雷打在甲上，沙子都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell; the sand glows.
The sand opens. Nothing below.
